semantic_guards: Exact part number remains the primary identity.
An unresolved Polish shop card is not evidence of withdrawal, incompatibility or unavailability.

Renault Shop records are not substituted for Polish Dacia Shop records.
Third-party records are not substituted for official Polish Dacia Shop records.
A missing current shop price is not a mismatch.
No master-data mutation is permitted in this reporting package.
